t: This is Baden-Powell House in South Kensington, now commonly called Queen's Gate House. It was built as a tribute to Lord Baden-Powell, the founder of Scouting, and it has served as the headquarters of The Scout Association. It's also been a hostel for Scouts, Guides, families and the general public, and it works as a conference and event venue. The architect was Ralph Tubbs, who is best known for the Dome of Discovery at the Festival of Britain on the South Bank in 1951.
